key_insight: ModHarness-RL treats an agent’s harness—the software scaffold controlling what the model sees and what guidance it receives—as a learnable program rather than fixed, hand-written rules. The harness evolves alongside model training.
problem_solved: Fixed harnesses cannot adapt to differences in domains, data, and models, or to a model’s changing needs during reinforcement learning.
method: Represent the agent harness as programs that control interaction visibility and guidance.
Learn these harness programs from data instead of relying solely on hand-written designs.
Evolve the harness as the model trains; the provided abstract is truncated and does not specify the optimization procedure.
impact: This approach could reduce manual harness engineering and make agentic RL scaffolding more adaptive. The provided excerpt does not report experimental results or measured performance gains.

paper_title: ModHarness-RL: Recasting Harnesses as Learnable and Evolving Programs for Agentic RL
paper_authors: Zelin He, Siyu Zhu, Jacob Helwig, Yujian Liu, Li An
